text:
The session wrote the triage note without opening any spec or code file the searches found, and it read `capabilities.md` in four slices.

- **No spec read:** Step 3 says to read what the searches find, and a `Covered by` row may only name ids the agent has read. The session read the task, the two rule files and `capabilities.md`. The spec content it saw came only from the grep output at turn 8. The code searches at turns 15-17 returned 38, 59 and 73 characters, and no file was opened to check them. The "no spec covers the new unit" conclusion at turn 19 and the gap classification rest on headings and search hits alone.
- **Sliced rereads:** `capabilities.md` was read four times in turns 10-13. The slices were 1104, 1500, 972 and 621 characters, so one read would have covered it.
- **Unfilled placeholder:** The intent says the conversation value is `⟨missing:settings.conversation⟩`, so the run gave no `never`, `blocking` or `always` value. The turns show no sign that the agent noticed or handled this. I can't tell how the missing value shaped the Findable/Owner decision rows, because the note text isn't visible.

The route fits the gaps: `discovery` with gaps, and no quick lane. The turn 21 summary is cut off, so I can't confirm the ARTIFACT lines or the wording about the note's completeness.

The session mostly followed the triage steps, but I found three problems: specs were never opened, one file was re-read in chunks, and the conversation value was never filled in.

- **Specs not opened (turns 8, 19, 20):** The procedure says to read each document it finds. The only look at specs was one grep (turn 8, 14 KB of matching lines). The agent opened no spec, decision record, research or plan file. The "what it covers" entries and the no-coverage verdict (turn 19) rest on grep lines alone. Turns 15–17 are code searches, and they returned only 38, 59 and 73 characters. The note says "none state the regeneration unit", which the agent never confirmed by reading a spec.
- **Chunked re-reads (turns 10–13):** `.tempergraph/capabilities.md` was read four times in small pieces (1104, 1500, 972 and 621 characters). The digest flags this as a repeated target. It cost three extra calls on a file of about 4 KB.
- **Conversation value missing (turn 20):** The prompt's `Conversation value` was the unfilled placeholder `⟨missing:settings.conversation⟩`. The `Owner decisions` rules depend on that value. The session shows no sign the agent noticed or recorded this when writing the note.

Both rule files, `task-notes.rule.md` (turn 2) and `documents.rule.md` (turn 3), were opened with the read tool as required. The header lists no prompt sections, lessons, skills or subagents, so there is no conformance to report.
